statBlock.name: Cultist
statBlock.classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any non-good alignment
statBlock.description: A follower of a demon lord, archdevil, or other dark power. Many hide their devotion from neighbors and authorities.

sections.Traits: Dark Devotion. It has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.
sections.Actions: Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Cult Fanatic
statBlock.classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any non-good alignment
statBlock.description: A cult leader who uses doctrine and personal influence to recruit followers and build power.

sections.Traits: Dark Devotion. It has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.
sections.Spellcasting:
4th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom. Spell save DC 11. Spell attacks +3.
Cantrips (at will): Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots): Command, Inflict Wounds, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon.
For magic item use and attunement, treat this NPC as a cleric with access to the cleric spell list.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 10 and 345. Includes official passive Perception and spellcasting corrections.

statBlock.name: Guard
statBlock.description: A watch officer, a fortified gate sentry, or a bodyguard hired by a merchant or noble.

sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing if used with two hands in melee.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 347. Includes the official addition for a two-handed melee spear strike.

statBlock.name: Gladiator
statBlock.description: An arena fighter. Some are pit fighters who expect every match to turn deadly. Others are prized duelists who rarely kill an opponent.

sections.Traits:
Brave. The gladiator has advantage on saves against being Frightened.
Brute. On a hit with a melee weapon, roll one more die of that weapon's damage. The attack entries already include the extra die.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing if used with two hands in melee.
Shield Bash. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature that fails a DC 15 Strength saving throw falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack would hit the gladiator, it can add 3 to its AC against that attack if it can see the attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

statBlock.name: Noble
statBlock.description: A noble or courtier whose money and connections buy influence. Guards and household servants often travel with them.

sections.Actions: Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack would hit the noble, they can add 2 to their AC against that attack if they can see the attacker and are wielding a melee weapon.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 348. Uses the officially corrected passive Perception.

statBlock.name: Priest
statBlock.description: A temple or shrine leader who teaches the faith and conducts rites. Acolytes often help with ceremonies.

sections.Spellcasting:
5th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom. Spell save DC 13. Spell attacks +5.
Cantrips (at will): Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots): Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Sanctuary.
2nd level (3 slots): Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level (2 slots): Dispel Magic, Spirit Guardians.
For magic item use and attunement, treat this NPC as a cleric with access to the cleric spell list.
sections.Actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Eminence. As a bonus action, spend a spell slot to add magical radiant damage to each melee weapon attack that hits until the end of this turn. A 1st-level slot adds 10 (3d6) radiant damage. Add another 1d6 per slot level above 1st.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 10 and 348. Includes official corrections to speed, Religion, and spellcasting.

statBlock.name: Veteran
statBlock.description: A professional fighter who takes up arms for pay or for a cause. They might have served in an army or spent years fighting on their own.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks. If the veteran has a shortsword drawn, it can also make one Shortsword attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing with two hands.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 350. Uses the officially corrected heavy crossbow damage.
